question: Will Mitch McConnell make a verifiable, live public appearance before 2027?
resolution_criteria:
This market resolves YES if Mitch McConnell makes a live public appearance, or appears in clearly same-day public video, before 2027.

Deadline: December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

To count, the appearance must be independently verifiable through a source such as C-SPAN, a Senate livestream, live TV, a public Senate proceeding, or footage/reporting from a major news organization.

It does not count if the only evidence is released by McConnell’s campaign, Senate office, family, allies, or personal/social media accounts.

Written statements, private calls, old footage, undated photos/videos, and claims that he is “working” or “recovering” without public visual evidence also do not count.

This market resolves NO if the deadline passes without a qualifying appearance.

# Research report 1 of 2

I couldn't confirm any qualifying live appearance between McConnell's last Senate vote in June and 2026-09-05. All direct page fetches failed with "proxy refused the connection," so every item below comes from search-result summaries. I left out all reporting dated after 2026-09-05.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no single URL. A qualifying appearance would have to show up on C-SPAN, a Senate livestream, live TV or in major news footage or reporting. Anything released by his office, family or social media accounts does not count.
- As of 2026-09-05 I found no qualifying live appearance since his last Senate vote in June. Sources disagree on that date: Alternet and LBC say June 11, NPR says June 14. [Alternet](https://www.alternet.org/mitch-mcconnell-disappearance/)

## 2. Current status
- Not settled. McConnell, 84, had been away from the Senate and out of public view for about 12 weeks. Every update since June has come as a written statement or an office-released photo, and neither counts under the rules.
- 2026-08-19: Northeastern Global News, "Ten Weeks Later, Where's Senator Mitch McConnell?", said he was still absent and out of the public eye. [Northeastern](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/08/19/sen-mitch-mcconnell-health-update/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- ~2026-09-03: House Oversight Chair James Comer said McConnell's staff told him they hoped McConnell would return when the Senate comes back into session on September 14. Comer said he had not spoken with McConnell directly. [CNN](https://us.cnn.com/2026/09/03/politics/mitch-mcconnell-return-senate), [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/comer-indicates-mcconnell-staffers-aiming-lawmaker-return-senate-later-month)
- Undated, likely late August or early September: spokespeople Stephanie Penn ("no scheduling announcements at this time") and David Popp ("we will be sure to let everyone know") gave no return date. [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/senate-returns-questions-remain-mitch-134137811.html)
- 2026-08-06: He was discharged from a rehab center to keep recovering at home with "intensive physical therapy." No return date was given. [NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/sen-mitch-mcconnell-discharged-rehab-center-hospitalization-june-rcna591235), [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/mitch-mcconnell-rehab-hospitalization/), [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/mitch-mcconnell-update-health-hospital-status-rehab-kentucky-12293763)
- 2026-07-28: Gov. Andy Beshear sent a letter asking for "proof of your capacity to serve" or that he leave office. Around the same time McConnell skipped the Fancy Farm picnic, and his office released a second photo. [Lead Stories](https://leadstories.com/hoax-alert/2026/07/fact-check-mitch-mcconnell-photo-released-in-july-2026-has-not-been-publicly-available-since-2023.html)
- 2026-07-12: His first statement on the illness said a fall at home left him briefly unconscious and that he also had mild pneumonia. He said there was no stroke, concussion or broken bones. His office released a photo of him with Elaine Chao holding that day's newspaper. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/mcconnell-provides-health-update-after-long-unexplained-absence.html), [ABC](https://abcnews.com/Politics/sen-mitch-mcconnell-hospitalized-due-fall-month/story?id=134699885)
- 2026-06-14 (some outlets say June 11): He was hospitalized. His office said he had "experienced several falls through the year" related to post-polio effects. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/mitch-mcconnell-says-hell-vote-in-senate-after-3-month-absence-from-fall-12441269)
- 2026-06-04: C-SPAN footage of an overnight vote-a-rama showed him nearly motionless. [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/renewed-concerns-mitch-mcconnell-health-cspan-footage-1816013)
- 2026-02-03: He was hospitalized with "flu-like symptoms." [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/02/04/mitch-mcconnell-hospitalized-flu-senate)

## 4. Base rates
- McConnell has come back after past health absences:
  - 2023: a concussion and rib fracture kept him out about 6 weeks.
  - 2019: he fractured his shoulder in a fall.
  - 2023: he had public "freezing" episodes and kept appearing afterward. [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/mitch-mcconnell-returning-senate-monday-fall/), [Global News](https://globalnews.ca/news/9859049/mitch-mcconnell-freeze-press-conference-health)
- Senators with long medical absences have usually returned before leaving office. Feinstein was out about 3 months in 2023, and Fetterman about 6 weeks. [Yahoo](https://news.yahoo.com/voices-injuries-illnesses-grind-senate-215634042.html?fr=sycsrp_catchall)
- He has had falls and hospitalizations several times in 2025 and 2026, and this is his longest absence yet at about 12 weeks. He is not running for re-election, and his term ends in January 2027.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Late August 2026: Polymarket's "McConnell casts a Senate vote by Aug 31" market fell to about 1% Yes, down from about 22% earlier in August. [Tech-Insider](https://tech-insider.org/mcconnell-public-appearance-prediction-market-odds-2026/)
- Manifold has this exact question, an appearance before 2027. A snapshot of unknown date showed about 57%. I could not load the live price. An earlier Manifold version, an appearance before Aug 3, stood at about 16% on 2026-07-11. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/yeeta/will-mitch-mcconnell-make-a-verifia-6lZQULNEc2), [Manifold earlier](https://manifold.markets/yeeta/will-mitch-mcconnell-make-a-verifia)
- I couldn't fetch a Daily Beast piece on Polymarket return odds, and I don't know its date. [Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/wild-odds-revealed-for-whether-mitch-mcconnell-will-show-up-for-work/)
- I found no Kalshi market.

## 6. Upcoming events
- 2026-09-14: The Senate reconvenes after its five-week recess. This is the date Comer said staff were aiming for. A floor vote would be covered live by the Senate feed and C-SPAN. [CNN](https://us.cnn.com/2026/09/03/politics/mitch-mcconnell-return-senate)
- September 2026: Government funding deadlines (the fiscal year ends Sept 30) and nomination votes could make his vote needed.
- October to December 2026: The Senate is expected to be in session around the midterms, with a lame-duck session after November 3. His term ends in early January 2027, which also brings the usual farewell speeches.

Sources: all links are given inline above.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

## Research brief: Will Mitch McConnell make a verifiable, live public appearance before 2027?

Cutoff: everything below was published on or before 2026-09-05.

### 1. Resolution source
- There is no single data feed. Resolution depends on independent verification such as C-SPAN, a Senate livestream, live TV, Senate proceedings or major news footage. Material released only by his office or family does not count.
- I could not load the Manifold market page itself; the proxy refused the connection. The question appears to come from that market. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/yeeta/will-mitch-mcconnell-make-a-verifia)
- Senate roll-call records would be the clearest proof: a floor vote is a public Senate proceeding. Through 2026-09-05 he had not cast a vote since June 11.

### 2. Current status (as of 2026-09-05)
- The question is not settled. I found no verified live or same-day public appearance by McConnell since he was hospitalized on 2026-06-14. All updates have been written statements from his office or his doctor.
- He is 84 and not running for reelection, so his term ends in January 2027. Health is the main obstacle to an appearance, not his schedule.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-04: Rep. James Comer said he expects McConnell back when the Senate reconvenes on Sept. 14. Comer said this was based on what staff told him; he had not spoken to McConnell himself. [WUKY](https://www.wuky.org/text/wuky-news/2026-09-04/according-to-gop-colleague-mcconnell-could-be-back-in-washington-later-this-month); [LEX18](https://www.lex18.com/news/covering-kentucky/kentucky-rep-james-comer-says-he-expects-mcconnell-to-return-when-senate-reconvenes)
- Early Sept 2026: A McConnell spokesperson told CNN there were "no scheduling announcements at this time." He missed all 60 roll-call votes between June 15 and Aug. 8. Some were calling for him to resign if he could not return. [Daily Wire](https://www.dailywire.com/news/top-republican-expects-mcconnell-to-return-later-this-month); [Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/top-republican-cornered-on-crucial-deadline-for-missing-mitch/)
- 2026-08-06: He said he had been discharged from a rehab center and would do "an intensive regimen of physical therapy from home during the state work period." This signalled he would not return before the recess. The Senate is scheduled to come back on Sept. 14. [ADN/AP](https://www.adn.com/nation-world/2026/08/06/sen-mitch-mcconnell-discharged-from-rehab-center-continuing-recovery-at-home/); [WJLA](https://wjla.com/news/nation-world/sen-mitch-mcconnell-says-hes-been-discharged-from-rehab-center-health-update-hospital-recovery-physical-therapy-kentucky-republican-politics-trump)
- 2026-07-25: The Washington Post reported growing questions about his absence, nearly six weeks after the fall. [WaPo](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/07/25/mcconnell-faces-growing-questions-about-absence-nearly-six-weeks-after-fall/)
- 2026-07-12/13: His first statement on his condition said a June fall left him "briefly unconscious" and that he then developed mild pneumonia. His doctor said tests found no fracture, stroke, cardiac problem or bleeding. [KVIA/CNN](https://kvia.com/politics/cnn-us-politics/2026/07/12/mcconnell-says-he-was-hospitalized-last-month-after-a-fall/); [WKYT](https://www.wkyt.com/2026/07/13/mitch-mcconnells-physician-explains-lengthy-hospital-stay/); [NOTUS](https://www.notus.org/senate/mitch-mcconnell-fall-pneumonia-hospital-stay-disclosed)
- Summer 2026: His absence held up Senate business, including the farm bill and some committee votes. [NOTUS](https://www.notus.org/senate/mitch-mcconnell-absence-senate-committees-votes)
- 2026-06-14: He was hospitalized after a fall at home. His last vote was on June 11.

### 4. Base rates
- 2023: He fell at a fundraising dinner on March 8, suffering a concussion and a rib fracture. He returned to the Senate in mid-April, about 6 weeks later. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2023/03/23/mcconnell-fall-return-senate-timeline); [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/mcconnell-to-return-to-the-senate-on-monday)
- He has a long record of coming back after health absences. The current absence (about 12 weeks by Sept. 5) is his longest. I found no systematic base rate for elderly senators returning after absences longer than 3 months. Past cases (for example Sen. Feinstein in 2023) did eventually return in person, though in frail condition.
- He has nearly four months left to appear (Sept. 5 to Dec. 31), and the Senate is in session for much of that time.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold: this exact question exists, but I could not retrieve the current probability. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/yeeta/will-mitch-mcconnell-make-a-verifia)
- Polymarket, "votes by Aug 31": YES fell to about 1% in late August, down from 22% earlier that month. [Tech Insider](https://tech-insider.org/mcconnell-public-appearance-prediction-market-odds-2026/)
- Polymarket, "returns to D.C. to vote by Sept 30": about 64% per the Daily Beast. I could not confirm when that figure was taken; it was probably August. [Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/wild-odds-revealed-for-whether-mitch-mcconnell-will-show-up-for-work/)
- DeFi Rate wrote that prediction markets expected him to stay in office rather than resign. [DeFi Rate](https://defirate.com/?p=16265)

### 6. Upcoming events that could move the outcome
- 2026-09-14: The Senate reconvenes after the recess. This is the date Comer and staff named as the "goal" for his return, and a floor vote would be broadcast and publicly recorded.
- Late September 2026: The government funding deadline at the end of the fiscal year, with close votes where his conference may need him. He has said he would show up for "tough votes" when needed.
- October to December 2026: The pre-election recess, then the lame-duck session after the Nov. 3 midterms. There are also possible farewell speeches before his term ends in January 2027.
- Risks on the NO side: his health could get worse, he could resign without appearing in person, or he could appear only in material released by his office or family, which does not count.
